description:
Snake, the way you remember it — only smoother. Guide your hungry snake around the garden, gobble up apples, and grow as long as you dare. Hit a wall or your own tail and it's game over.

Movement glides between squares instead of jumping, so every turn feels precise. Steer however you like: swipe anywhere, tap the on-screen d-pad, or use the arrow keys. The pace picks up as you eat, and golden stars appear for a few seconds at a time for bonus points if you're quick enough to grab them.

Simple to pick up, surprisingly hard to put down. How long can you get?
whatsNew: Golden bonus stars, a gentler speed curve for the first few apples, and a two-turn input buffer so quick corner moves never get dropped.
